ctx.x: was called Sporty and later became Fump in Cab Calloway's band and later became The Judge which everybody calls me to this very day. So this is a part of our heritage, a nickname.

Of course. It wasn't a nickname, it was a case of identity, special identity. You know Mr. Red Allen used to always say, 'My man,' because you do not have that kind of a mentality to remember everybody's name, number, and rank. When you're traveling around the way we was traveling around - and you must remember with the various peoples, that a Zutty Singleton, or any one of us, even yourself, various peoples that we meet in traveling around throughout the world, we have to have an identity.
